name: Cadence 1
description: Basic attack strikes enemies to your front and sides with the element of your necklace.  Scales with WIS.

name: Crescendo 1
description: Spends harmony built by your current song to heal you and your group within 6 tiles.  Your current song then adds it's own burst; - Mending: Shields, - March: rallies on top of its own bonus for 8s, - Bulwark: Lifts every affliction it knows, - Dirge: Wails at nearby enemies.  The heal and burst scales with harmony spent (except Bulwark).

name: Mind Hymn 1
description: Siphons 15% of the targets max mana (of what they have left).  Mana beyond your maximum is lost, and a target with 0 mana will give nothing.
